# 1. Scientific path

```text
Exact retained PTC parent
          |
          v
Exact lossless balance representation -> assignment design
          |
          v
Active detector sign assignment -> frozen ordinary MAP operator
          |
          v
NOI-GEN members -> design-ignorable all-member admission
          |
          v
NOI-UNC conditional marginal second moment
          |
          v
NOI-STD independently realized MAP / conditional scale
```

Each arrow is an identity and admission boundary, not automatic realization.
The sign enters once, only on the PTC signal occurrence. The unsigned
denominator, projection, WCS, support, coverage, response, validity, and every
other MAP gate remain fixed.

# 2. Scope, request state, and exact design

Base v0.1 owns one ensemble per exact observation and TolTEC array, with no
cross-observation randomization or randomized coadd. `not_requested` and
`explicitly_disabled` both have zero requested cardinality and no members or
downstream products, but only the latter retains exact request/effective-plan
identity plus disabling owner, policy, and cause. An enabled request is a
positive integer and resolves atomically or fails completely.

Positive coefficient-mass detectors are grouped by exact readout network.
Zero-mass, zero-total, ambiguous-membership, and singleton states keep their
approved dispositions. Independent symmetric candidates are first-accepted
under every exact network condition, with a positive finite cap, fail-closed
exhaustion, replacement, valid duplicate draws, separately represented
complement orbits, and no forced complement pair.

Every balance value is a canonical reduced arbitrary-precision rational. For
each contribution, decoding the rational equals the exact contribution used by
the frozen MAP parent. The encoding binds the parent and coefficient
generations, exact projection and coefficient payload, representation source,
and digest. It is never rounded from display text, re-estimated, independently
quantized, or used to replace MAP numerical arithmetic. Without a lossless
encoding, design resolution is unavailable.

# 3. Scientific target law and deterministic replay

For each active network stratum, the exact balance rule defines an admitted set
`A_h`; canonical stratum concatenation defines `A=product_h A_h`. Before exact
key resolution, the declared scientific ideal model is independent uniform
with-replacement draws from `A`. First-accepted rejection has this conditional
law because every admitted candidate has the same base probability and the
common earlier-rejection factor cancels.

The scientific randomization measure, the ideal candidate-bit/key-selection
law, and the deterministic replay map are different objects. After key binding,
the realized sequence is exactly `F(K,plan)`. Replaying the same bound key,
counters, serialization, and plan must reproduce the assignments independent
of scheduling or layout. That exact equality establishes identity, not
statistical independence, random-generator adequacy, or estimator uncertainty.
Base v0.1 therefore adopts owner disposition B: iid uniformity is the declared
ideal randomization model, while generator/randomness adequacy belongs to a
separately named validation layer.

# 4. Protecting the target from member selection

The ideal `Uniform(A)` target survives member completion and admission only
when their binding conjunction `R_b` is fixed before assignment or invariant
under assignment/member output. Output amplitude, sign pattern, source imprint,
map morphology, tail value, and assignment-dependent QC can be advisory, but
cannot remove a member from the base estimator.

An assignment-dependent execution or numerical failure makes the exact base
method unavailable. Regenerating the failed design under the same method
identity until a favorable all-pass result appears is prohibited. If an output-
dependent gate is scientifically necessary, it defines another method whose
target is explicitly conditioned on selection and whose estimator, weights,
uncertainty, and claim change accordingly. The unconditioned target cannot be
retained by assertion.

# 5. Conditional UNC realization and STD meaning

Set/count equality is a realization condition, not a statement about every
failed attempt. Realized initial UNC implies identical resolved/admitted member
sets and equal positive requested, resolved, completed, and admitted counts.
Only then does the known-zero-center estimator exist on the exact common domain
with divisor `N_resolved`. If UNC is unavailable or failed, actual counts and
causes remain factual and may be unequal; no survivor estimator or changed
divisor exists.

The primary product remains
`conditional_detector_sign_randomization_marginal_second_moment`. Its equality
to target-law marginal variance follows from the known ideal target center,
not from finite-ensemble centering. Source and structured residual imprint can
remain. It is not physical-noise variance, total uncertainty, complete
covariance, precision, or calibrated significance.

STD divides independently governed `m_MAP` by the compatible square-root
conditional scale. It remains a nonlinear data-dependent product. MAP response
divided by the scale is only a fixed-scale partial derivative; full response
also needs separately authorized conditional-moment response and remains
unavailable. The product has unit `1` and only the bounded standardization
claim.

# 7. Proposed scientific-owner freeze disposition

The implementation-independent contract is coherent and scientifically
freezeable conditional while exact numerical coefficient/coverage parents,
ordinary numerical MAP/NOI realization, revised profile approval/binding,
complete STD response, implementation conformity, and empirical validation
remain unavailable or unassessed. Those conditions block their dependent
products and claims; they do not prevent contract freeze. This package proposes
that disposition but is not itself frozen.

No implementation conformity, random-generator validation, calibration,
physical-noise validity, covariance completeness, Gaussian significance,
achieved performance, readiness, production suitability, or production
authorization is claimed.
